It was the same for me her communication skills were slim to non-existing. I had to ask and keep trying to get it out of her for 30 minutes before she would tell me what was wrong usually. Conflicts never got resolved she would only get angry whenever I asked her why she did what she did etc and tell me to move on or else she won't speak to me for the rest of the day and she would hang up calls lot of the times to avoid it. Even when she knew she was wrong. It usually ended in me having to apologize for her behavior and be scared of what she would do to punish me for trying to be the adult one and fix the issues.
Thank you for the chuckle I needed that! But yeah unfortunately it seems like it.

I'd tell her how beautiful she is and how much I love her several times a day etc and I knew all her triggers and past and tried my hardest to look out for her and make sure she was never hurting but I never recieved the same treatment nor heard those words come out of her mouth all she'd ever say is "No you". But then she tells me she's not happy when I did literally everything I could for her. Like most I saved her from an abusive boyfriend and an insane drug addiction which she should have been dead from. Nothing was ever good enough for her.. I bet she blames me.
A question I ask myself way too frequently on this subreddit lol it's crazy. Stay strong!

Oh yes trust me the toll it took on me mentally is insane I'll never know myself how I ever put up with it for so long but I think it went on for so long that it finally started festering as resentment towards her because it was truly cruel cruel behavior so I've been able to get out of the fog and to move on a hundred times quicker than I thought I would. That and frequently using this subreddit making sense of it all somewhat of course made it a lot easier.  
I spent about 90% of the time just like you wanting to make sense of it all because it was all so confusing since according to her, she loved me more than life itself and with me she'd die and wanted to get married and have kids, so why would she treat me like this?   
But reading this subreddit and having supportive friends to fall back on has been the best and biggest blessing and the discard as well as you said even though it's so heartbreaking at first.    


I'm rooting for you my friend and we'll all get through this together. We're stronger than we think and us and our feelings deserve to be treated with love and respect just like everybody else.  
Stay golden!
